title: 第1740章 栽赃陷害卡又又被发现了第1739章 报应来了阴云笼罩
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
【叮！检测到苏卿雪大仇得报，对主人产生无比浓烈的感激和爱慕之情，好感度上升1点，当前好感度95点！】
脑海中回荡的系统提示，让夜云眼前一亮。
终于够了！
达到九十五点好感度，就意味着苏卿雪对夜云现在是至死不渝。
而且由于好感度达到了新的阶段，夜云也将会收获一笔反派值。
【叮！检测到重要人物苏卿雪对主人的好感度已经达到95点，恭喜主人获得反派值3000点，小反派宝箱x1！
当前拥有反派值点！】
又有一万出头的反派值了，还得到了一个小反派宝箱。
夜云摊开右手，刚刚获得的小反派宝箱出现在他手中。
打开小反派宝箱，当宝箱开启的刹那，绽放出一阵微弱的金色光芒。
随着金光逐渐散去，一张颇为精致的卡片出现在宝箱中。
夜云随手取出卡片，开启的小反派宝箱也随之消失。
【栽赃陷害卡】：可以指定某一目标，将自己所做的某些事情栽赃给对方（使用时指定目标，心中想象需要栽赃陷害的事情即可。）
竟然还有这玩意儿！
把玩着这张精致的卡片，夜云感到意外的同时又觉得很有趣。
若是把自己做的某些事情，栽赃陷害给气运之子，想来一定会非常有趣。
但目前暂时没有合适的目标，只能先留着。
这种好东西，一定要选定一个合适的目标使用才行，不然可就太浪费了。
收好栽赃陷害卡，夜云重新躺下，悠哉悠哉地摇着躺椅。
苏卿雪刚才有注意到，夜云手上好像拿了什么东西，只是转眼间就消失不见了。

“云弟，刚刚那是什么？”
闻言，夜云神秘一笑。
“好东西，以后你就知道了。”
见夜云并没有详细解释，苏卿雪也没有继续追问。
既然夜云不说，那自然有他的道理。
好感度已经达到九十五点的苏卿雪，根本不会怀疑夜云所说的任何话。
她对夜云为自己所做的一切很是感动。
若不是夜云，她就算能够独自回到外域，想要报仇，也很难实现。
甚至很可能报仇不成功，反倒是会身死道消。
是这个男人救了自己，也是他帮自己找回了记忆，更是他替自己完成复仇。
苏卿雪已经下定决心，无论以后发生什么事情，都一定要追随夜云的脚步。
这时，在一旁盘膝坐着，全程操控魔傀的焱黎，猛地睁开眼睛。
迅速起身，焱黎微蹙着眉说道。
“主上，魔傀下毒一事虽然隐蔽，但他刚到冥鬼教总部，就出了这种事情，现在已经被怀疑了。”
就在刚才，五长老去找了魔傀，就是想要探探魔傀的口风。
焱黎所操控的魔傀表现得十分淡定，像什么事情都没发生一样。
没能探出什么口风的五长老只能退去，但对魔傀的怀疑，却没有半点减少。
“怀不怀疑都不影响，魔傀本来就只是一颗棋子罢了。
其实既然已经发挥了相应的作用，留不留下都不重要。”
从一开始，夜云就没有考虑过魔傀会不会不被怀疑。

被怀疑了也无所谓，只要能够达成目的即可。
content_en:
【bite! It was detected that Su Qingxue's great revenge was avenged, and she felt extremely strong gratitude and admiration for her master. Her favorability increased by 1 point, and her current favorability is 95 points! 】
The system prompts echoing in his mind made Ye Yun's eyes light up.
Finally enough!
Reaching ninety-five points of favorability means that Su Qingxue is committed to Ye Yun until death.
And because the favorability has reached a new stage, Ye Yun will also gain a villain value.
【bite! It has been detected that the important person Su Qingxue's favorability towards the master has reached 95 points. Congratulations to the master for getting 3000 villain points and 1 small villain treasure chest!
Currently has villain value points! 】
Another villain was worth over 10,000 yuan, and he also got a small villain treasure chest.
Ye Yun opened his right hand, and the treasure chest of the little villain he had just obtained appeared in his hand.
Open the treasure chest of the little villain. When the treasure chest is opened, a faint golden light blooms.
As the golden light gradually dissipated, a rather delicate card appeared in the treasure box.
Ye Yun casually took out the card, and the little villain's treasure chest that he opened also disappeared.
[Framing Card]: You can designate a certain target and frame certain things you have done on the other party (when using it, just specify the target and imagine the things that need to be framed.)
There is such a thing!
Playing with this exquisite card, Ye Yun was surprised and very interesting at the same time.
It would be very interesting to think about framing some of the things I did on the son of luck.
But there is currently no suitable target, so I can only keep it for now.
This kind of good thing must be used on a suitable target, otherwise it will be too wasteful.
After putting away the frame-up card, Ye Yun lay down again, rocking the recliner leisurely.
Su Qingxue just noticed that Ye Yun seemed to have something in his hand, but it disappeared in the blink of an eye.
"Brother Yun, what was that just now?"
Hearing this, Ye Yun smiled mysteriously.
"Good stuff, you'll know about it later."
Seeing that Ye Yun did not explain in detail, Su Qingxue did not continue to ask.
Since Ye Yun didn't say anything, he certainly had his reasons.
Su Qingxue, whose favorability level has reached 95 points, will not doubt anything Ye Yun says.
She was very touched by what Ye Yun had done for her.
If it weren't for Ye Yun, even if she could return to the outer realm alone and seek revenge, it would be difficult to achieve it.
It is even possible that the revenge will not be successful, but will lead to death.
It was this man who saved him, who helped him regain his memory, and who accomplished his revenge for himself.
Su Qingxue has made up her mind that no matter what happens in the future, she must follow Ye Yun's footsteps.
At this time, Yan Li, who was sitting cross-legged and controlling the demon puppet, suddenly opened his eyes.
Standing up quickly, Yan Li said with a slight frown.
"My lord, although the poisoning by the demon puppet was hidden, this happened as soon as he arrived at the Hell Ghost Cult headquarters, and he is now suspected."
Just now, the fifth elder went to find the demon puppet, just to find out what the demon puppet said.
The demon puppet controlled by Yan Li acted very calmly, as if nothing had happened.
The fifth elder, who was unable to find out anything, could only retreat, but his suspicion of the demon puppet did not diminish at all.
"It doesn't matter whether you have any doubts or not, the demon puppet is just a chess piece.
In fact, since it has already played a corresponding role, it doesn't matter whether you stay or not. "
From the beginning, Ye Yun never considered whether the demon puppet would not be suspected.
It doesn't matter if you are suspected, as long as you can achieve your goal.
